name: Springville Museum of Art
description: A historic Spanish-colonial-style art museum in Springville with galleries, a sculpture garden, and indoor and outdoor event spaces.
priceText: Garden only $805–$995; Main Level $925–$1,135; Main Level + Garden $1,730–$2,130
seatedText:
Dumke Gallery 48
Sculpture Garden 54
Atrium 63 seated dinner

items.label: Description
items.value: A historic Spanish-colonial-style art museum in Springville with galleries, a sculpture garden, and indoor and outdoor event spaces.

items.value:

items.label: Price
items.value: Garden only $805–$995; Main Level $925–$1,135; Main Level + Garden $1,730–$2,130

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Main Level + Stewart Sculpture Garden: 6.5-hour private after-hours rental with event hosts and basic table and chair setup — Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri or Sat 4pm-10:30pm — $1,730-$2,130 ($600 deposit)
Main Level only, same inclusions — $925-$1,135 ($300 deposit)
Sculpture Garden only, same inclusions — $805-$995 ($300 deposit)
Additional gallery (private after-hours) — $115-$150/hour ($100 deposit)
Semi-private daytime rental (Atrium or Garden), 1.5 hours — $80-$105/hour ($100 deposit)
Specialty setup or mid-event setup change — $40+
Specialty audio/visual setup — $69.50/hour
Upright piano (select locations) — $25

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$600 deposit (Main Level + Garden)
$300 deposit (Main Level or Garden only)
$100 deposit per additional gallery

items.label: Seated
items.value:
Dumke Gallery 48
Sculpture Garden 54
Atrium 63 seated dinner

items.label: Main Level + Stewart Sculpture Garden
items.value: Setting: indoor+outdoor · Seated: 63 (Atrium) / 48 (Dumke Gallery) / 54 (Garden) · Standing: 750 · Price: $1,730-$2,130 for 6.5 hours · Deposit: $600 · Notes: Only sheet that lists Weddings

items.label: Main Level
items.value: Setting: indoor · Seated: 63 (Atrium) / 48 (Dumke Gallery) · Standing: 450 · Price: $925-$1,135 for 6.5 hours · Deposit: $300

items.label: Diane and Sam Stewart Sculpture Garden (with Smoot Pavilion)
items.value: Setting: outdoor · Standing: 400 · Price: $805-$995 for 6.5 hours; semi-private $80-$105/hour · Deposit: $300 ($100 semi-private)

items.label: Atrium (semi-private daytime)
items.value: Setting: indoor · Seated: 63 · Price: $80-$105/hour, 1.5 hours · Deposit: $100

items.label: Grand and East Galleries (upper level)
items.value: Setting: indoor · Seated: 99 (Grand) / 20 (East) · Price: $115-$150/hour as additional gallery; semi-private $60-$85/hour · Notes: Grand piano; concerts, recitals, ceremonies

items.label: Utah Families Foundation Youth Gallery (lower level)
items.value: Setting: indoor · Seated: 104 dinner / 100 lecture · Standing: 200 · Price: $115-$150/hour as additional gallery; semi-private $60-$85/hour · Notes: Projector and screen

Stewart Sculpture Garden with Smoot Pavilion

items.label: 50 in. wrought-iron tables with chairs (Atrium only, seat 6)
Av
items.value: flat screen (renter provides slideshow); CD player; iPod cable; microphone with stand; microphone with podium; speakers in Atrium, Dumke Gallery and Foyer; Wi-Fi

items.label: Piano
items.value: Upright piano, $25 (not in the Swanson Gallery)

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Food staging area with oven, counters, sink and fridges
Bridal party may change in the lower-level restrooms

items.label: Times
items.value:
Private events: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 4pm-10:30pm
Semi-private (Atrium, Garden): Tue-Sat 10:30am-3:30pm; Sun 3:30pm-5:30pm

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Closed Sundays and holidays
Tours by appointment (Tue 11am-2pm, Wed 5pm-8pm, some Saturdays)
Floor plan must be approved by the event coordinator one week before the event
Nothing may be placed between the dashed line and the walls; grey areas are closed during events
Wrought-iron tables only in the Atrium; piano not usable in the Swanson Gallery

items.label: Elevator
items.value: Elevator to all levels and restrooms

items.label: ADA restrooms
items.value: Accessible restrooms on the main and lower levels

items.label: Accessible parking
items.value: Accessible parking in the east lot

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
ADA accessible (except the Swanson Gallery)
Elevator to all levels
Wheelchair available at the front desk
Accessible parking in the east lot
Accessible restrooms on the main and lower levels
Ramps to the front doors

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Free parking lot directly east of the Museum
Additional free parking west of the Museum on 100 E

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Rates come from an undated rate-sheet PDF on smofa.org that the current Rentals page no longer links; the Rentals page and FAQ say to contact the event coordinator for rates
Weddings are listed on the Main Level + Garden sheet; the Main Level and Garden sheets list receptions
Photo sessions are free with a booked rental (otherwise $40 per 1.5 hours)

items.value:

Email: gwoolf@springville.org
